summary: @servicetitan/html-sketchapp preinstall fetches Bun runtime to execute obfuscated bundled payload
details: package.json declares scripts.preinstall="node setup.mjs". setup.mjs is an obfuscated launcher (mangled identifiers, per-function string-alias objects) that at install time downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases into the OS tmpdir, chmods it executable, and then execFileSync's it against a sibling file math_init.js. math_init.js is a ~727KB obfuscated `// @bun @bun-cjs` bundle at the tarball root using string-array rotation (function WV8StW shifting array n7gIxM) with mangled identifiers, and it is not listed in package.json's `files` manifest. The advertised purpose of the package (HTML to Sketch conversion) does not require the Bun runtime. This is the alternate-runtime dropper pattern: a second interpreter is fetched at install time specifically to execute an opaque sibling payload that Node-based scanners will not evaluate, and the launcher itself is obfuscated to hide what it does.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
